learningOutcomes: Explore Java exceptions, concurrency, I/O and network APIs.
Relate JDBC and Servlets to server application development.
entries.title: Advanced Java Programming
entries.summary: Continues Java programming beyond CS 55 with advanced APIs and platform-independent application development. Covers exceptions, multithreading, multimedia, I/O, JDBC, Servlets, RMI, and networking.

learningOutcomes: Describe relational data modeling and normalization.
Use SQL to create, retrieve and manipulate data.
entries.title: Database Concepts & Applications
entries.summary: Explores relational database design, normalization, data integrity, and concurrency control. Students apply concepts using MySQL, creating and managing data with SQL and stored programs.

learningOutcomes: Explain addressing, protocols and network architectures.
Relate subnetting and server services to connected applications.
entries.title: Network Fundamentals and Architecture
entries.summary: Covers core networking concepts and architectures, including topologies, protocols, addressing, subnetting, and distributed systems. Includes hands-on labs with server tools and real-world services.

learningOutcomes: Compare cloud services and deployment concepts.
Evaluate technical and business benefits of cloud computing.
entries.title: Introduction to Cloud Computing
entries.summary: Introduces cloud computing and its shift from local infrastructure to scalable internet-based systems. Covers cloud technologies, services, providers, career paths, and industry demand.

learningOutcomes: Describe EC2 and Elastic Beanstalk application deployment.
Explain load balancing and scalability in distributed cloud systems.
entries.title: Compute Engines in Amazon Web Services
entries.summary: Explores cloud architecture using AWS services like EC2 and Elastic Beanstalk. Focuses on distributed systems, scalability, and core design principles for building cloud-native applications.

prerequisites.description: CS 79A and (CS 55 or CS 87A or CS 83R or CS 85)

learningOutcomes: Explain the AWS Shared Responsibility Model.
Relate layered controls to confidentiality, integrity and availability.
entries.title: Security in Amazon Web Services
entries.summary: Focuses on securing systems and data in AWS. Covers the Shared Responsibility Model, AWS security tools, and how automation and layered controls protect cloud infrastructure.

learningOutcomes: Identify HTML, CSS and JavaScript roles in web applications.
Practice browser-based page structure and interactions.
entries.title: Internet Programming
entries.summary: This course covers the basic technologies used to program Web-based applications. Topics include: HTML5, Cascading Style Sheets (CSS), XML and JavaScript, along with a basic survey of the latest extensions on JS.

learningOutcomes: Use JavaScript programming concepts.
Connect client-side JavaScript to the document object model.
entries.title: JavaScript Programming
entries.summary: Introduces core programming concepts using JavaScript for client-side web development. Covers the DOM and building interactive, high-performance websites with visual or audible outputs.

learningOutcomes: Explain server-side form processing with PHP.
Connect dynamic web pages to backend data.
entries.title: PHP Programming
entries.summary: Introduces PHP for server-side web development, focusing on processing form data, accessing databases, and generating dynamic web pages with embedded PHP in HTML.

learningOutcomes: Use Python syntax, control flow, strings and I/O.
Describe classes and regular expressions.
entries.title: Python Programming
entries.summary: Introduces Python programming, covering syntax, control flow, I/O, strings, classes, and regular expressions across various application domains using Windows or Mac environments.

learningOutcomes: Identify the starting materials for studying cloud computing.
entries.title: Cloud course introduction and learner lab orientation
entries.summary: Provides a course introduction and an AWS learner-lab orientation. External lab participation may require separate course access.

learningOutcomes: Distinguish browser and server responsibilities.
Describe lists and form controls in an HTML page.
entries.title: Introduction to HTML5 and web concepts
entries.summary: Introduces client-side versus server-side programming, HTML lists and forms.

learningOutcomes: Explain the role of CSS in page presentation.
entries.title: Styling web pages with CSS3
entries.summary: Introduces styling web pages using Cascading Style Sheets.

prerequisites.description: Suggested learning sequence within this course, not an official enrollment prerequisite.

learningOutcomes: Use conditions and loops for small browser interactions.
entries.title: JavaScript interactions and control flow
entries.summary: Practices browser prompts, alerts, conditions, loops and output.

prerequisites.description: Suggested learning sequence within this course, not an official enrollment prerequisite.

learningOutcomes: Explain how the DOM represents page content.
entries.title: Document Object Model
entries.summary: Introduces the Document Object Model through a web programming assignment.

prerequisites.description: Suggested learning sequence within this course, not an official enrollment prerequisite.

learningOutcomes: Compare XML and JSON as data representations.
Identify the role of jQuery in browser scripting.
entries.title: jQuery, XML and JSON
entries.summary: Introduces jQuery and the XML and JSON data formats.

prerequisites.description: Suggested learning sequence within this course, not an official enrollment prerequisite.

learningOutcomes: Recognize JavaScript values, types and operators.
entries.title: JavaScript values, types and operators
entries.summary: Introduces JavaScript values, types and operators, alongside development environment setup.

learningOutcomes: Organize a small JavaScript program with conditions and loops.
entries.title: JavaScript program structure
entries.summary: Practices external JavaScript, FizzBuzz, conditions and loops.

prerequisites.description: Suggested learning sequence within this course, not an official enrollment prerequisite.

learningOutcomes: Break small calculations into functions.
Describe a Git-based development workflow.
entries.title: Functions and Git workflow
entries.summary: Introduces functions through a math toolkit exercise and covers Git and GitHub workflow.

prerequisites.description: Suggested learning sequence within this course, not an official enrollment prerequisite.

learningOutcomes: Represent structured data with objects and arrays.
entries.title: JavaScript objects and arrays
entries.summary: Explores data structures through reading-tracker review and personal data object exercises.

prerequisites.description: Suggested learning sequence within this course, not an official enrollment prerequisite.

learningOutcomes: Understand the breadth of frontend and backend web engineering.
Distinguish a personal learning plan from academic program requirements.
entries.title: Web developer program overview
entries.summary: The published roadmap describes frontend and backend web development across browser technologies, frameworks, cloud hosting, networks, databases and security. It presents a course-taking sequence and recommends an academic counselor for an individual educational plan. Program information is labeled effective Fall 2023; it is not a current enrollment or graduation eligibility determination.
